name: 62223 · Belleville, IL
findings: ZIP 62223 (Belleville) has 60 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62223 (Belleville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 62223 (Belleville) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
